experience.title: Cascade Memory: Dependency-Mediated Belief Revision for LLM Agent Memory
experience.meta: Student Researcher · Advisor: Dr. Bing Luo, DKU
bullets: Identified a failure mode in LLM agent memory: when an upstream belief changes, downstream beliefs it supports are not revised, and retrieval keeps returning them as if still valid.
Designed Cascade Memory, a neuro-symbolic mechanism that propagates each source-fact update to every dependent belief, withdrawing a belief only when all of its support is defeated.

Implemented the update pipeline with an explicit dependency graph, an assumption-based truth maintenance system (ATMS), SAT-based entailment, ordered belief-base contraction, and on-the-fly dependency discovery.
Built the full evaluation harness for the STALE (n = 400) and MEME (n = 694) agent-memory benchmarks.
Reached 66.7% on STALE and 93.52% on MEME, vs. 60.3% and 58.07% for the strongest same-backbone external baselines; 96.0% / 96.3% / 88.5% on MEME's Deletion, Cascade, and Absence tasks.
Showed gains over the LLM-only configuration on MEME across all four backbones tested.

experience.title: DIR: Decoupled Instruction Refinement for Narrative Generation
experience.meta: Student Researcher · Advisor: Dr. Bing Luo
bullets: Identified a gap in closed-loop instruction refinement: when a model generates, judges, and rewrites its own instruction, it is unclear whether the result transfers to other models or only compensates for that model's quirks.
Designed DIR so that the generator, evaluator, and instruction optimizer can each be a different model.
Built a single-iteration refinement loop that diagnoses a draft on eight narrative dimensions, rewrites the instruction from that diagnosis, and regenerates the draft.
Evaluated seven configurations on 100 WebNovelBench samples, with GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, and GPT-5.1 in crossed generator/optimizer roles.

Found that cross-model transfer is real but modest: GPT-4o-refined instructions improved GPT-4o-mini (+0.049 normalized score; gains on 69% of samples), and GPT-5.1-refined ones improved GPT-4o (+0.035; 58%).
Owned the full experimental pipeline (ablations, paired tests, effect sizes, and figures).

experience.title: Towards Self-Evolving Narrative Systems with LLMs
experience.meta: Student Researcher · Advisor: Dr. Bing Luo · Co-first author
bullets: Framed the system requirement: react to unscripted player actions in real time while staying faithful to the authored story — a structured feedback loop rather than prompting alone.

Led the design and implementation of a three-stage system: offline compilation of scripts into modular narrative trees, semantic matching of player input to tree nodes, and cross-session prompt refinement from player feedback.
Coordinated a team of six; designed experiments and ran a 12-participant user study (5-point scales).
Found gains in coherence (+0.5) and NPC consistency (+0.4), with a small drop in player agency (−0.2) that exposes a structure-versus-freedom trade-off.
Identified three recurring play styles through qualitative coding of open-ended responses.

experience.title: Decentralized Multi-Agent Assembly
experience.meta: Team Member · Advisor: Dr. Bing Luo · National Undergraduate Innovation Program
bullets: Contributed to a decentralized framework for dynamic manufacturing assembly: each agent selects actions based on the observed environment state and the predicted behaviors of other agents.
Proposed a hierarchical reinforcement-learning model for resource allocation and task scheduling, reducing conflicts in simulated collaborative assembly tasks.
